name: Cragside Adventure Play Area
description: Adventure play area beside Crozier car park on the Carriage Drive, with a log mountain and balance beams, the witch's hat climbing structure, climbing frames, a zip wire and slides through tunnels. On foot from the main car park it's a steep gravel climb past Slipper Lake.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the National Trust page for prices. National Trust members get in free.
